Fresh HTTP 200 yielded the retained complete PDF, SHA-256 8812e21426954c0e17100bd0e3f2ce0a5c24b8ef6cc8dbddb0bff12fdf8848e7. Checked page streams and rendered page witnesses. Printed p. 16 (physical PDF p. 16), §10.2 Type-bound procedures, opening paragraph and ProcedureHeading / Receiver productions. Section 10.2 explains the binding in prose before specifying where the optional receiver occurs in the general procedure-heading production. The square brackets around VAR in the grammar are constrained by the prose. A record is passed as a variable parameter, and a pointer to that record is passed as a value parameter. The rule concerns a type-bound procedure and its receiver, with the procedure and record type declared in the same module. This documents the bound procedure heading and receiver forms in the identified report. Compiler extensions and whole-program conformance require separate evidence. Reading the grammar alone could suggest any receiver type or mode. The preceding paragraph narrows permissible combinations and requires the record declaration in the same module.
